note: Every creative value in this file is an analytical assumption defined by the project, not a claim that it performs better. Values are generic and contain no brand names.

seasons.note: Assumption: generic seasonal directions chosen by the project; not tested for performance.

spring.scene: city park or tree-lined street with early greenery

summer.scene: coastal promenade or open rooftop at the end of the day
summer.lighting: warm evening sunlight, long soft shadows

autumn.scene: street or park with fallen leaves in warm tones
autumn.lighting: low golden-hour sunlight, warm color temperature

winter.scene: cold urban street or snowy outdoor setting
winter.lighting: cool overcast daylight with soft contrast

department_model.note: Business rule: the department is a descriptive label from the data; scene and styling stay identical across departments and only the model differs. Avoid stereotypes in pose, setting, styling and wording. Assumption: the model wording below.

formats.note: Project-defined working sizes, not official platform specifications. Assumption: chosen as common working sizes for the Stage 6 automation.

restrictions.note: Business rules / decisions defined by the project for every generated output.
all_modes: human review is required before any output is considered valid
demo_mode: no brand names or logos in generated text or imagery
label the output as illustrative: not a TheLook product
the reference image must be one the project owner has the right to use; its license is verified in Stage 6
production_mode: a reference image of the real product is required
the product is never altered or invented: shape, color, details and logo stay as in the reference image
in production mode, lighting and color guidance applies to the scene around the product; the product itself is never retouched or altered

lewis_aida.title: E. St. Elmo Lewis
lewis_aida.caveat: AIDA is attributed to Lewis (1898) mainly through Strong's 1925 book; Lewis never presented a fixed formula or used the acronym.

adler_canon.author: Lindsay Adler
adler_canon.title: Photography Essentials for Fashion Bloggers Part 1: Lighting and Exposure Fundamentals

house_fstoppers.author: Peter House
house_fstoppers.title: How to Light Clothing Like a Product Photographer
house_fstoppers.caveat: Does not cover ghost mannequin; flat lay appears only in comments.

dutile_dps.author: Matt Dutile
dutile_dps.title: 3 Ways to Improve Your Images With Composition
dutile_dps.caveat: No studies or data; the rule of thirds is not a hard rule.

adobe_color_wheel.title: The color wheel explained and how colors work together
adobe_color_wheel.caveat: Its wording on triadic and split-complementary is inconsistent, so only complementary and analogous are used.

squareshot_ecommerce.title: E-commerce photography tips to boost your online sales
squareshot_ecommerce.caveat: No data behind its claims; weakest source, used only for catalog conventions.

singh_2006.author: S. Singh
singh_2006.title: Impact of color on marketing
singh_2006.caveat: Reports inconsistencies and controversies in color psychology; used only to justify excluding color psychology.

creative_approaches.note: Assumptions grounded in documented design practice (see sources); not tested for performance.

studio_hero.purpose: show the garment as the single protagonist
studio_hero.lighting: large diffused soft light, key light close to the camera axis, gentle fill, no hard overhead light
studio_hero.composition: garment centered or on a third line, front or three-quarter view, minimal props
studio_hero.background: plain neutral, evenly lit, no color cast

lifestyle_context.purpose: show the garment worn in the seasonal scene so the viewer can imagine using it
lifestyle_context.lighting: natural soft light; avoid harsh overhead sun; choose the light direction that flatters garment and model
lifestyle_context.composition: model in the seasonal scene from the seasons section; rule of thirds as a guide; keep clean negative space for text in wide formats

detail_closeup.purpose: show fabric, stitching and construction details
detail_closeup.lighting: soft low-contrast diffused light that keeps fine detail
detail_closeup.composition: tight crop on texture, collar, closure or stitching; no model required

flat_lay.purpose: show the whole garment shape from above
flat_lay.lighting: large diffused light, same angles repositioned for a surface
flat_lay.composition: top-down view, garment spread out, consistent spacing, minimal relevant props
flat_lay.note: weaker support: commercial blog plus comments; manual selection only, never a default

default_approach_by_format.note: Assumption: default creative approach per format. flat_lay is never a default.

color_harmony.guidance: choose background and scene palette relative to the garment color: complementary for contrast, analogous for cohesion
color_harmony.note: design harmony only; no psychological claims about colors

aida_note.note: AIDA (attention, interest, desire, action) is used only to label each approach's role. The action stage is out of scope because price and calls to action are not part of the image. The mapping is a project assumption.
